en: Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a busy European square with ornate late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings, shop awnings, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians. A decorative column or statue stands in a small garden in the foreground. Prominent façades include an Art Nouveau building labeled "AMERICAN HOUSE" and adjacent shops with large glass windows. Storefront signage in Hungarian is visible on multiple buildings.
